shortDescription: JetBlue (NASDAQ:JBLU) today launched new daily nonstop service between Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and Alfonso Bonilla Aragón International Airport (CLO), serving Cali, Colombia. The launch marks another milestone in JetBlue’s expansion in both South Florida and Colombia…

children: ) today launched new daily nonstop service between Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and Alfonso Bonilla Aragón International Airport (CLO), serving Cali, Colombia. The launch marks another milestone in JetBlue’s expansion in both South Florida and Colombia, giving customers a new nonstop option between Fort Lauderdale and one of Colombia’s largest cities, while providing travelers from Cali with convenient connections through FLL to destinations across the airline’s growing network.

Cali becomes JetBlue’s fourth destination in Colombia, joining Cartagena and Medellín, and follows the airline’s launch of Fort Lauderdale–Barranquilla service earlier this month. The additions deepen JetBlue’s presence in a region that remains an important part of its network, with Latin America and the Caribbean accounting for approximately one-third of the airline’s overall capacity.

Known as the “Salsa Capital of the World,” Cali is renowned for its music and dance culture and serves as a major commercial and cultural center in southwestern Colombia. The new daily service creates a convenient nonstop link to South Florida, supporting travel for customers, visiting friends and relatives, exploring the region or traveling for business.

“The addition of Cali marks another important milestone in JetBlue's continued growth in Colombia, extending our award-winning service and competitive fares to even more customers,” said Daniel Shurz, senior vice president, revenue, network and enterprise planning, JetBlue. “This new service gives customers more options to travel between Colombia and South Florida, and connect beyond Fort Lauderdale, reflecting our continued commitment to the country and our focus on growing in markets where we see strong customer demand and opportunities to offer greater choice and competition.”
Growing JetBlue's Largest-Ever Fort Lauderdale Network

Cali’s launch comes as JetBlue continues a significant expansion in Fort Lauderdale, the airline’s first destination and a major focus city in its network. JetBlue now offers more flights and nonstop destinations from FLL than any other airline.

In July, JetBlue launched nonstop service from Fort Lauderdale to eight destinations in a single week. Since December 2025, the airline has added 12 nonstop destinations from FLL and increased daily departures by more than 75% compared with the same period last year. The growth continues in November with new service to Columbus (CMH), Indianapolis (IND) and San Diego (SAN). This winter, JetBlue expects to operate over 150 daily departures from Fort Lauderdale during peak travel times, its largest schedule ever at FLL, giving South Florida customers more options across the United States, Latin America and the Caribbean.
Daily service between Fort Lauderdale (FLL) and Cali (CLO)

JetBlue will operate the Cali route on its Airbus A320 aircraft, featuring the airline's signature Main customer experience with free high-speed Fly-Fi®, seatback entertainment with live TV at every seat and complimentary snacks and drinks.1
EvenMore customers enjoy added benefits including extra legroom, priority security where available, early boarding, dedicated overhead bin space and additional onboard perks.
To celebrate today’s launch, for a limited time, travelers can take advantage of one-way fares from Fort Lauderdale to Cali starting at $139 in Main and $239 in EvenMore on jetblue.com.2

JetBlue is New York's Hometown Airline®, and a leading carrier in Boston, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood, Los Angeles, Orlando and San Juan. JetBlue carries customers to more than 100 destinations throughout the United States, Latin America, the Caribbean, Canada and Europe. For more information and the best fares, visit jetblue.com.
